# Generate peripheral registers

The control registers of the X-ALP peripherals are described in HJSON files and generated with [OpenTitan's `regtool.py`](https://opentitan.org/book/util/reggen/index.html), vendored in `hw/vendor/x-heep/pulp_platform/register_interface/vendor/lowrisc_opentitan/util/regtool.py`. The generation is driven by the `reg-gen` target of the top-level Makefile, which `make mcu-gen` calls automatically:

```bash
make reg-gen
```

The target is incremental: it only regenerates the outputs whose HJSON description changed.

## Generated files

For a peripheral named `<name>`, the description is `hw/ip/<name>/data/<name>.hjson` and the generated files are:

| Output | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `hw/ip/<name>/rtl/<name>_reg_pkg.sv` | SystemVerilog package with the register types and constants |
| `hw/ip/<name>/rtl/<name>_reg_top.sv` | SystemVerilog register file (register interface) |
| `sw/device/lib/drivers/<name>/<name>_regs.h` | C header with register offsets and field masks |
| `sw/device/lib/drivers/<name>/<name>_structs.h` | C structs header with typed access to each register (only for "full" peripherals) |
| `sw/device/lib/drivers/<name>/<name>_regs.md` | Markdown documentation of the registers |

The generated files are not tracked by git (see `.gitignore`).

## Adding a peripheral to the generation

The peripherals are listed in three Makefile variables, depending on what has to be generated:

| Variable | Default | Generates |
|----------|---------|-----------|
| `REG_GEN_PERIPHERALS` | `fast_intr_ctrl soc_ctrl` | RTL, C header, C structs and docs |
| `REG_GEN_PERIPHERALS_BASIC` | | RTL, C header and docs |
| `REG_GEN_PERIPHERALS_MCU_BASIC` | `pad_control` | Same as `BASIC`, for peripherals whose HJSON is itself generated by `mcu-gen` from a `.hjson.tpl` template |

To add your peripheral, place its description in `hw/ip/<name>/data/<name>.hjson` and add `<name>` to the matching list in the `Makefile`.

## The AXI LLC registers

The `axi_llc` IP is vendored with its own HJSON description and RTL register file. For it, only the C header and the docs are generated, in `sw/device/lib/drivers/axi_llc/`, from `hw/vendor/pulp_platform/axi_llc/data/axi_llc_regs.hjson`. The vendored RTL is not regenerated.

## Boot ROM

The boot ROM includes the generated headers of the SoC controller and of the LLC. `make boot-rom` rebuilds it; run it after a register description of these peripherals changes, since the boot ROM rule does not track the generated headers.
